"""Camera-guided cabinet controller, using only the real-robot client interface.
Run interactively to perform deliberate, observed action chunks.
"""
import json, os, sys, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
os.makedirs('/app/output/observations', exist_ok=True)
with open('/app/output/spec.json','w') as f: json.dump(spec,f,indent=2)
cams = list(spec['cameras'])
k = 0
obs = None
history=[]
def record(res):
    global obs,k
    obs=res
    path=f'/app/output/observations/{k:03d}'
    res.save(path)
    with open('/app/output/latest.json','w') as f: json.dump(res.meta,f,indent=2)
    np.savez('/app/output/latest_depth.npz',**res.depth)
    print('OBS',k,'PATH',path,'time_left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'))
    print('PROPRIO',json.dumps(res.meta.get('proprio')))
    k+=1
    return res

def look():
    return record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none'))

def act(n=1, arm=(0,0,0), rot=(0,0,0), grip=-1, base=(0,0,0), torso=0, mode=-1, note=''):
    a=np.zeros((n,12));a[:,:3]=arm;a[:,3:6]=rot;a[:,6]=grip;a[:,7:10]=base;a[:,10]=torso;a[:,11]=mode
    history.append(dict(n=n,arm=arm,rot=rot,grip=grip,base=base,torso=torso,mode=mode,note=note))
    with open('/app/output/actions.json','w') as f: json.dump(history,f,indent=2)
    return record(r.submit('ee_delta',a,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none',note=note))

def point(cam,u,v):
    d=obs.depth[cam]; d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
    z=float(d[int(v),int(u)])
    cal=obs.meta['cameras'][cam]
    K=np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(cal['cam2world_gl'])
    p=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1.])*z
    return (T@np.r_[p*[1,-1,-1],1])[:3]

print('SPEC',json.dumps(spec))
look()

import numpy as np

def cloud(res,cam):
    d=res.depth[cam]; d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
    cal=res.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(cal['cam2world_gl'])
    v,u=np.indices(d.shape)
    p=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],-d],axis=-1)
    return p@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]

def door_plane(res,cam,box):
    u0,v0,u1,v1=box
    p=cloud(res,cam)[v0:v1,u0:u1].reshape(-1,3)
    # Robust fit a vertical plane from a user-selected visible panel region.
    xy=p[:,:2]; rng=np.random.default_rng(1); best=None
    for _ in range(200):
        a,b=xy[rng.choice(len(xy),2,replace=False)]; direction=b-a
        if np.linalg.norm(direction)<0.01: continue
        normal=np.array([-direction[1],direction[0]]);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal)
        dist=abs((xy-a)@normal);keep=dist<.005
        if best is None or keep.sum()>best.sum(): best=keep
    q=xy[best]; w,V=np.linalg.eigh(np.cov(q.T)); direction=V[:,-1]
    if direction[0]<0: direction=-direction
    angle=np.arctan2(-direction[1],direction[0])*180/np.pi
    print('PLANE',box,'left opening angle deg',round(angle,2),'inlier fraction',round(float(best.mean()),2),'center',q.mean(axis=0))
    return angle
